data.name: Evac Point
data.detailed_description:
The city is dying. Your only mission is to leave it alive.

Evac Point is a survival shooter built around one clear objective: start at one end of a devastated town and reach the evacuation point. The map is large, the journey is long, and the danger never stops. Expect a minimum 2+ hour run where every detour costs time, every fight drains resources, and every decision can decide whether your squad makes it out.

Play solo or in online co-op (up to 3 players). Switch freely between third-person and first-person view to match your style, aim, and awareness. Scavenge buildings and streets for supplies, craft essential items on the move, and keep your team alive while hunger and thirst pressure you to keep searching.

Zombies are not the only threat. Armed groups roam the city, guarding key areas and turning the streets into sudden firefights. You don’t build a base. You don’t “settle in.” You push forward, adapt, and survive long enough to see the extraction zone.

Key Features

  • A Long-Form Escape: a large level designed for a minimum 3+ hour journey to evacuation

  • Solo or Online Co-op (Up to 3 Players): coordinate, share supplies, revive, and fight as a team

  • TPS/FPS Toggle: switch viewpoints anytime for comfort and tactical advantage

  • True Survival Pressure: manage hunger and thirst by finding food and clean water

  • Scavenge & Craft: gather resources, manage inventory, and craft essentials while moving

  • Multiple Threats: face zombies and hostile factions across a collapsing urban route

data.short_description: Evac Point is a co-op survival shooter where you cross a massive post-apocalyptic town to reach extraction. Manage hunger and thirst, scavenge supplies, craft what you need, and fight through zombies and hostile factions in a long, high-stakes escape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB / RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. 1080p Low/Medium settings. Headphones recommended for best experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended. 1080p High settings target. Use headphones for positional audio.
